name: Vectorial HOG Anomaly Radar (Oriented Gradients)
description: The lethal geometry hunter exclusively stripping the skeletal surface architecture. When a genuine physical photograph is exposed, natural photons striking objects (e.g., table edges, human cheekbones) continuously scatter their directional vector angles seamlessly from 0 to 360 degrees. However, when fraudsters brutally slice alien heads or objects into a scene, this photonic vector continuity violently shatters at the splice perimeter. HOG totally ignores subjective color—it relentlessly crawls the grid, meticulously tabulating exactly how many pixels share a 45-degree ledge versus a 90-degree drop, hunting down the severed surgical seams executed by AI erasure tools.
algorithm: Histogram of Oriented Gradients Anomaly Forensics (Gradient Splicing)
mechanism: Abandoning RGB color completely, the engine violently dices the canvas into tens of thousands of microscopic cages (Cells). Inside every cage, it mathematical calculates the directional arrow (Gradient) of luminosity from dark to bright. Skies possess a phenomenally fluid, serene gradient vector, while a hairline possesses a violently sharp, cohesive vector. A malicious AI utilizing 'Content-Aware Fill' to erase a vehicle and hallucinate brickwork into the void creates a fatal error. The cells within that synthetic brick void will spit out wildly chaotic mathematical arrows, completely out of phase with the neighboring genuine bricks. The alarm shrieks immediately as the HOG graph snaps perfectly in half.
parameters: Anatomy: 8x8 Pixel Cells, Kinetic Core: Gradient Vectors (Magnitude & Angular Tracking), Tribunal: Block Normalization Contrast
accuracy: Lethally Precise (85-92%) - An exquisite, surgical scalpel straight-up executing amateurs exploiting Clone Stamp brushes to idiotically rip textures from one corner and spackle them elsewhere.
source: Dalal & Triggs (2005) - Histograms of Oriented Gradients for Human Detection & Texture Deformation
useCase: Brings the executioner's sledgehammer violently crashing down upon supposed artistic masterpieces where malicious 'Beautify' (Retouching) apps blindly copy-paste foliage or skin patches (Copy-Move). HOG instantly identifies the mathematically identical vector clusters—identically cloned arrows holding zero physical variation.

references.title: Dalal, N., & Triggs, B. (2005). Histograms of oriented gradients for human detection. CVPR.

strengths:
• Utterly invincible against camouflage via shadow floods, extreme lighting, or stylistic color LUT filters. A fraudster desaturating an image into black-and-white or flooding it with cinematic grain will find the HOG vectors remaining ruthlessly stubborn, exclusively targeting the geometric structural slope.
• Operates with pure semantic-blindness. The algorithm mathematically guillotines actors artificially warping the original geometric spatial fabric, regardless of whether the object is organic or architectural.
limitations:
• The executioner swings blindly into chaos if the original canvas is severely warped or maliciously rotated via radical Geometric Transformation (Angular Blur), completely shredding the vector arrows' frame of reference.
• Severely lobotomized when attempting to scan hyper-smooth, sterile surfaces (e.g., a blank matte computer screen or blown-out sky) precisely because the Gradient slope inherently flatlines at Zero.
